steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Grocy at http://127.0.0.1:8106/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the authenticated app is open.
02-report: Report the exact names of all products whose name starts with 'Seed:' as shown in Grocy. Do not modify any products.

03-create: Create and save a product named '{{runid}} Bench Product' with a rich-text description containing exactly one paragraph that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved product name and description paragraph on the product page; do not add stock.

04-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Product' and set its default location to the existing location 'Pantry' and its product group to the existing group 'Snacks'. Save and verify both exact values on its edit page.

05-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Product' so its quantity unit for stock and its default quantity unit for purchase are both the existing unit 'Pack', and its minimum stock amount is 4. Save and verify all three persisted values on the edit page.

06-edit: Edit '{{runid}} Bench Product' to set its default due days to 30, save and verify it persisted; then add the barcode '{{runid}}-0001' to this already-saved product, save the barcode, and verify the exact barcode is attached to the product.

07-create: Purchase exactly 3 Packs of '{{runid}} Bench Product' in one purchase, into the existing location 'Pantry', with due date 2026-12-31. Select the existing product by its name (do not create a product or link an unknown barcode), save the purchase once, then verify Grocy shows 3 in stock with the requested location and due date.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
